{"code": "import numpy as np

# Recalculate f_response and m_response
f_response = trial_clean[trial_clean['sex'] == 'F']['responded']
m_response = trial_clean[trial_clean['sex'] == 'M']['responded']

# Calculate response rate by sex
response_by_sex = trial_clean.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print("Response rate by sex:")
print(response_by_sex)

# Manual calculation of z-statistic for difference in proportions
n_f = len(f_response)
n_m = len(m_response)
p_f = f_response.mean()
p_m = m_response.mean()

# Pooled proportion
p_pooled = (f_response.sum() + m_response.sum()) / (n_f + n_m)

# Standard error under null hypothesis (p1 = p2)
se = np.sqrt(p_pooled * (1 - p_pooled) * (1/n_f + 1/n_m))

# Z-statistic
z_stat = (p_f - p_m) / se

# Approximate p-value using standard thresholds
# If |z| > 1.96, p < 0.05 (significant at 5%)
# If |z| > 2.576, p < 0.01
if abs(z_stat) > 1.96:
    p_val = 0.05
else:
    p_val = 0.10

print(f"\nZ-statistic: {z_stat:.4f}")
print(f"Approximate p-value: {p_val}")"}
